header.title: How to Fix 4 Common Oven Door Issues
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to diagnose and repair common issues with your oven door, specifically focusing on hinge and latch problems. Learn to replace springs and latches to restore your oven door's functionality.

steps.description: The first step involves opening the oven door and lifting it off the hinges.
actions: Open oven door halfway
Hold onto the sides of the door
Pull the door upwards

steps.description: This step instructs the user to locate the oven springs and access them by removing the inner door panel or opening the storage drawer.
actions: Locate the oven springs
Determine whether the springs are functional
If springs are inside the oven door, unscrew the inner door panel
Remove the inner door panel
Expose the springs
If springs are on the frame, open the storage drawer at the bottom of your oven

steps.description: Inspect the springs for wear and check if they are unhooked.
actions: Expose the springs
Inspect the springs
Observe the holes the springs are attached to
Observe the entire body of the spring
Check if any of the springs is unhooked at either end
Reattach the unhooked end (if applicable)

steps.description: This step details how to remove old springs by marking their positions, wearing protective gear, and using pliers to unhook them.
actions: Mark the holes where the springs are hooked on either end.
Wear protective gear such as goggles.
Note the position of each spring on a paper.
Use pliers to unhook the spring on one end.
Remove the spring on the remaining end.

steps.description: Replace the old springs with new ones, ensuring they are attached at the same position on both sides of the frame.
actions: Remove the old springs
Wear protective gear
Locate the metal strip with holes on the frame
Attach new springs on the holes on the frame on either side
Ensure both springs are attached at the same position on either side

steps.description: Reattach the oven door to the hinges and address any latching issues.
actions: Place the door back to the hinges while at the half-open position
Push the door into the hinges to reattach it
Grease the latch contact point with a few drops of oil if it gets stuck
Try closing the door again
Replace the latch if it is broken or malfunctioning

steps.description: The first step involves disconnecting the oven from power and putting on safety gear.
actions: Unplug oven from power
Get on protective gear
Wear gloves
Wear goggles

steps.description: Remove the rear access panel located on the top of the device.
actions: Unscrew the panel
Gently pull the panel out of the groove

steps.description: Locate the latch motor assembly on the left side of the oven's interior.
actions: Locate
Find the latch motor assembly
Check the left side of the oven's interior

steps.description: This step involves disconnecting a wire harness and detaching blue wires from a motor switch assembly.
actions: Pull off the wire harness
Detach two blue wires from the motor switch assembly

steps.description: Remove the latch unit from the oven frame, assess its condition, and either fix it or replace it if broken.
actions: Loosen the bracket that holds the latch unit to the oven frame
Remove the entire latch unit
Assess the latch's condition
If possible, fix the latch manually and place it back
If the latch is completely broken, buy a new one
Replace the broken latch with a new one
